Engineering Math: How Long Will the Anker SOLIX F2000 / PowerHouse 767 (2,048Wh / 2,400W / 30A RV) Run a 26 cu. ft. French-Door Fridge w/ Ice Maker?

A 26 cu. ft. French-Door Fridge w/ Ice Maker draws 220 continuous running watts and demands a 1,450-watt starting inrush surge (Dual-Evaporator Compressor) when cycling on. With a typical 45% duty cycle, it consumes an average of 99 Wh per hour.

Net Usable Battery Energy = 2,048 Wh × 0.85 (AC Inverter Efficiency) × 0.923 (BMS Cutoff Reserve) = 1,608 Wh
Average Hourly Energy Draw = 220 W × 0.45 (Duty Cycle) = 99 Wh/hr
Real-World Runtime         = 1,608 Wh ÷ 99 Wh/hr = 16h 14m
